title: Mark: review the did_webvh deviations before IETF 127 (opaque<V> carriage, AGENTS.md crate map)
description: 1. Decision mimid-1wgh.4.81.8: mimid carries DIDWebVHCredential inside opaque<V>, not as -00 writes it, because OpenMLS and mls-rs carry every unknown credential type as one opaque<V>. This is the first feedback item for -01 (docs/didwebvh-draft-feedback.md item 1); worth saying at the session that the first implementation hit it. 2. AGENTS.md's crate map has no row for the new crate mls-didwebvh (pure, sync, no OpenMLS; depends on jmap-did-types at the crate-jmap rev mimid pins; mimi-mls depends on it). Agents were told not to edit AGENTS.md. 3. Decision mimid-1wgh.4.81.16 narrows mimid-1wgh.4.33 (required_capabilities) for did_webvh groups.
notes: Crate map entry added (3c27c09). Remaining: Mark to review decision mimid-1wgh.4.81.8 (opaque<V> wrapper) before the MLS session on Fri 20 Nov.
